asr.full_text: Cryptocurrency Cryptocurrency Cryptocurrency Cryptocurrency 60 days has passed and over 50,000 miners in over one hundred and eighty three countries worldwide History is about to repeat itself Welcome to the future of cryptocurrency The biggest innovations and companies that changed our lives overnight are internet-based companies that build new global communities online. Apple, Google, Facebook. Cryptocurrency is the future of money transactions online. The timing could not be better. Bitcoin shows us the way, but the best is still to come. A new, innovative crypto coin is aiming for the sky and will become one of the most successful currencies on the crypto market. OneCoin has a powerful founder with a strong vision. Dr. Luja Ignatola is a financial and legal expert, well known in financial circles, with excellent education and experience in banking and finance one of the few in opposition to the financial sector she is passionate about the future of virtual currency always striving to be on top of the game and dedicated to achieve her ambitious goal to make one coin one of the world's leading currencies

textual.potential_relevance: A cryptocurrency-growth comparison (“The next Bitcoin”) and favorable founder-credential claims are presented alongside a signup destination and contact method, creating a claim-to-requested-action relationship that needs later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish what the signup page requests, whether any payment or transfer occurs, the identity of the contact, the accuracy of the claims, or any outcome for viewers.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin as the next Bitcoin and as a cryptocurrency that will become one of the market's most successful currencies, using future-value and success claims to encourage participation. The description provides a direct OneCoin signup URL and contact address, showing that the message is a solicitation rather than neutral cryptocurrency commentary.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S05 fits because the video promotes a token, compares it favorably with Bitcoin, and links participation to claims that OneCoin will become a leading and highly successful cryptocurrency. The supplied evidence does not show a specific payment amount or completed purchase, but it does show token promotion tied to anticipated market success and a signup pathway.
